purpose: Bind mesh facts and retained source storage to actual owned buffers and public borrowed view slices.

counterexamples.fresh_geometry_oracles: All pass; exact rational cube controls.

cache_audit.guard: position buffer and borrowed position slice

derived_rule: Read matched current source validity and publish into newly constructed destinations.
borrowed_view_rule: position_owner compares complete pointer and length before sharing native source positions. geometry_facts also checks triangle slice identity. Changed views cannot read or publish original facts. Native presence only chooses fresh compact plane construction, not its mathematical source.
compatibility_and_memory: Two Weak slice identities prevent allocation-address reuse while facts survive. Arc::make_mut detaches; Arc::get_mut can return None even with one strong owner, as disclosed in public docs.
Weak does not retain the source slice value, but keeps its backing allocation until the last weak reference drops. Cached bounds/planes may independently retain scalar values.
Edited meshes bypass old facts until rebuilt. Unchanged clones retain certificates. Topology-only edits preserve position facts.
The former 80-byte fact header budget is increased only by two Weak field sizes. Actual layout, allocation and binary costs remain to measure. This is a correctness repair, not a performance claim.
